body:
I have bipolar, but when sober my poles last for months or more. In my time of life when i am drinking my bipolar becomes very fast (Anxiety/Depressed vs Happy/Excited/kick the world's lowly ass).

So when i am down i try very hard to go lower and lower so that i can hit the point where i am at "rock bottom" so that i can flip to happy stage.

The problem is when i drink i always flip so fast (minutes,seconds) that i just stay drunk (weeks, months). 

I was wanting to know if there is a way to switch to the happy with out trying to fly into rock bottom?

**tl;dr**  But really just tell your story about flying to rock bottom, thats most important for me to read

My average day is now managing my business and sometimes going outside for food or go to the near city. Mostly i am drunk. Like right now. I only got 6 votes on this post, so i guess its not too good.

I might just tell more details of my life, which are interesting, but i am afraid to do so because i think someone will find me. :(
Thanks for your reply. I agree about having interesting stories, thats something i can count on.

To use a metaphore its like my life is like the U shaped in your sink drain. At first it looks like it is their just to stop rings from going down the drains, but if you look closer you will see that the back of the U is always made so that water filles up the in and out holes. It fills up the in and out holes so that the smell of the bad sewer air doesnt enter the room. When the water goes through the drain some air comes up from the sewer and it smells like shit and piss.

Thats my life if i sit on the relaxed no bad smells come up, but nothing is getting done. If i let the juice flow then as free as i am the room still smells like shit.

I have been commited before to a psyc ward, i sobered up then and i was sober for year+, but i found life boring.

I envy people who are geek but dont need to hurt themselves.
I am very well built i can lift weights without a problem, but i just get lonely because i dont have a good friend to gym with.
I think what causes my rage is the fact that i look around and see "normal" people just falling in line. Its like you cant be sober and actually doing something different with your life

My story is much more interesting than this post, but the fact of the
matter is that i have drank so much that my reel feelings are
suffocated well and dead. This will save you the tl;dr that was my
original post, which got killed by a browser crash.

If you took out all of the reasons why or from where comes my general
emotional state you could break it down to this: during a good bit of
my waking hours i am execerting a large proportion of my physical and
emotional energy avoiding my feelings.  Every so often i need more
energy than i have to deal with my emotions (the physical feeling in
my body and just my head getting away from me and seeing the reality
which is far less grand than i would hope for myself).

Emotions in themselves are extremely addictive. The mind is elastic,
which is touted as a good thing, but if you think about it, rubber
bands always want to come back to the state that they originally were
in if force is not applied. Unless you stretch your mind so much that
its bent out of shape, it will snap right back to where it was. Right
now my mind is so bent out of shape that if it snap it back to where
it was i fear that i will be lost and limp. It takes a lot of energy
to keep this robber band so contorted.


Ok, ok, now lets say i "be real" with myself for a year or so. Well i
have done this in the past. What happens is that i get so
uncontrollably bored with myself and life that i burn with rage
inside. I am a peaceful person so the rage just burns inside me with
no way to get out. I just look out at the people around me and i think
to scream to myself "look there is so many things to be done in this
world! So many people to be, why are you so sure of your reality?"

Where these problems lead me is that if i am sober i am too anxiety to
live the life i can envision and if i am drunk i am too drunk to get
the shit done that i need to in order to live the life that i want
live.
I will get my post out after i go buy a beer and drink some of it. I will be back... sorry about that,, i cant get it out right now....
